description: Spreads a carrier signal across up to sixteen polyphonic output channels, the modulator voltage deciding which channels it reaches and in what proportion.

params.text: Sets how many output channels the carrier is spread over, 2 to 16.
Shifts the block of active channels up the polyphonic cable, by 0 to 14 channels.

inputs.text: Sets which output channels the carrier reaches: 0-10V is divided by the number of active channels, and within each division the carrier crossfades from one channel to the next. Monophonic.
The signal spread across the output channels; with nothing patched a constant 10V is used. Monophonic.
A polyphonic signal whose channel is sent to the matching output channel, attenuverted by the carrier level on that channel; unconnected channels are ignored.

outputs.text: The polyphonic result, one channel for each active channel.
